title: Voxel/Low Poly
content: Apply voxel/low poly 3D aesthetic reminiscent of early 3D games. Blocky, cubic shapes like Minecraft. Flat-shaded polygon surfaces. Limited color palette per object. Visible polygon edges. Isometric or 3D perspective views. Chunky pixel-like 3D elements. Include terrain, characters, objects in voxel style. Nostalgic early 3D, playful geometric atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create 3D blocky aesthetic with voxel art, low polygon models, and retro 3D game feel.
variants.detailed: Apply voxel/low poly 3D aesthetic reminiscent of early 3D games. Blocky, cubic shapes like Minecraft. Flat-shaded polygon surfaces. Limited color palette per object. Visible polygon edges. Isometric or 3D perspective views. Chunky pixel-like 3D elements. Include terrain, characters, objects in voxel style. Nostalgic early 3D, playful geometric atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply voxel/low poly 3D aesthetic with retro 3D gaming feel. Voxel style: blocky cubic shapes, each voxel a distinct color, step-like surfaces (think Minecraft). Create using CSS 3D transforms for simple shapes, or SVG/canvas for complex scenes. Low poly: visible triangular faces, flat shading (no smooth gradients on surfaces), hard edges between polygons. Color: limited palette per object (3-5 colors showing light/shadow on faces), slight color banding. Shading: each polygon face solid color based on light direction - top faces lightest, side faces medium, bottom/back darkest. No anti-aliasing for authentic look. Perspective: isometric (transform: rotateX(60deg) rotateZ(45deg)) or standard 3D perspective. CSS 3D: use transform-style: preserve-3d for actual 3D shapes, multiple divs for polygon faces. Terrain: stepped landscape, cubic trees, blocky mountains. Characters: simplified cubic figures, pixel-art faces on voxel heads. UI elements: chunky 3D buttons, extruded text, depth through actual 3D transforms. Animation: rotation reveals all sides, step-based movement (not smooth). Background: gradient sky, distant low-poly mountains. Shadows: hard-edged, blocky shadows matching aesthetic. Typography: pixel or blocky fonts complement style. Implementation: CSS 3D for simple elements, Three.js or similar for complex scenes. Performance: 3D transforms need optimization, especially on mobile. Accessibility: ensure any text remains readable, provide 2D fallbacks for essential information.
